commits.subject: board(AJCR): replace base-field genus charts by descent
commits.summary: **Route correction.** Reject the unconditional base-field genus atlas after the divisor-degree obstruction, archive its stale claim, and claim finite-separable genus-chart descent under DAT-G.

commits.subject: AJCR: prove the genus multi-index arithmetic obstruction
commits.summary: **Obstruction.** Pointwise coverage forces a nonempty chart index, and a nonempty family of legal indices at parameter n exists exactly when n is a divisor degree; multiple genus charts cannot remove the missing genus-degree condition.
